Job Title: Client Relationship Lead

International SOS is the world’s leading medical and security services company with over 12,000 employees working in 1,000 locations in 90 countries. International SOS Government Services administers the TRICARE Overseas Program providing high-quality, accessible health care services for U.S. Military service members, family members, retirees, and other eligible beneficiaries overseas.

About the role

We’re seeking a dynamic and experienced professional to join our senior management team as a Client Relationship Lead. In this pivotal role, you will serve as the primary subject matter expert for our clients, fostering strong relationships with key stakeholders to ensure the seamless delivery of services and exceptional satisfaction with the TRICARE Overseas Program (TOP).

This role is a high-impact position and requires someone with exceptional networking abilities to influence and drive positive outcomes.

Location:

Remote working- with frequent travel across Germany

Why This Role is Exceptional:

- **Strategic Influence:** Shape the success of the TRICARE Overseas Program by building and nurturing high-level relationships with military and civilian partners.
- **Global Impact:** Work closely with Military Treatment Facilities, Bases, and Remote TOP Dedicated Network Sites worldwide to ensure the highest quality of service.
- **Flexibility and Travel:** Choose between a home-based or office-based position with the opportunity for international travel, allowing you to directly engage with stakeholders and make a difference on a global scale.

If you are a proactive, relationship-driven professional with a passion for healthcare and the military community, we’d love to hear from you!

Key responsibilities

- Lead, coordinate and drive the overall contractual KPI deliverables for Military Treatment Facilities (MTF), engagement, coordination of collaboration across all client and TOP stakeholders, securing access to care, contractual provider availability and network services, medical records collections, claims handling, beneficiary services.
- Oversight and support in the coordination of execution of all tasks that impact the MTF through in-country personnel (clinical/non-clinical) in the Area of Responsibility (AOR).
- Maintain and strengthen relationships with stakeholders by means of identifying and communicating client needs in a timely manner
- Provide ongoing support and education to above mentioned stakeholders on TOP Policy, processes, and any self-service mechanisms in place.
- Ensure the MTF or Military Units/Clinics have access to the contractually required Host Nation Network
- Develop a good understanding of internal operations by means of collaboration with cross functional teams and support the seamless execution of all contractual aspects through other departments and teams
- Represent voice of both customer and business by means of analysing and documenting client feedback thus influencing the direction of the Program.
- Develop a solid understanding of the value-added proposition offered by the TOP Program to promote maximum utilization of the various benefits available
- Identify business opportunities and share best practices amongst colleagues and stakeholders.

About you

- Significant Account Management experience and/or managing complex client programs required
- Healthcare Administration experience preferred 
- Bachelor's degree
- Excellent English language skills
- People leadership, influencing and organizational skills
- Strong analytical capabilities
- Self-motivated problem solver
- Ability to travel across Germany with own car

Benefits

- Bonus scheme
- Warm, supportive, and open company culture
- An opportunity to learn and develop in a global environment
- Remote working with some travel requirements
- Birthday holiday and option to purchase additional annual leave
- Comprehensive Benefits Package: Private Pension, Private Medical Insurance, Life Assurance and more

jobs.description:
Job Description

About the role

As a Product Quality Engineer, you will be expected to step into the game and display your excellent quality mindset to help drive our innovations beyond industry standards

What you will do

- Represent the Quality Management within the development team
- Correlate the SiC failure mechanisms with reliability measures to be implemented into the product quality
- Support the definition and execution of qualification activities for SiC product developments
- Contribute to the implementation of quality procedures and quality standards (Nexperia, JEDEC, AEC, and customer-specific) within projects

- Support the definition of qualification requirements and qualification of manufacturing processes
- Maintain documentation and handle data in analysis tools for Reliability, Yield, FMEA, Customer Requests, and related activities
- Perform analyses to identify root causes of yield loss or production issues and support the implementation of containment and corrective actions
- Prepare initial input for PCNs, support review and release activities, and contribute to follow-up actions

What you will need

- Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Physics or a similar discipline
- Experience in a similar position is desirable and experienced in wafer fab and assembly processes preferred
- Knowledge in semiconductor physics as well as in semiconductor applications in the SiC domain
- First knowledge of international quality standards and policies e.g. AEC-Q101, AQG 324
- Familiar with measurement methods and equipment as well as device testing environments
- Familiar with standard software tools (e.g. Office), problem solving techniques
- High-quality mindset and ability to work under pressure
- Fluent spoken and written English skills
- Strong know how in statistical data analysis
- Good communication and presentation skills
- Good team player and willingness to travel
- Assertiveness and demonstrated influencing skills
- Open mindset, which welcomes changes and views problems as opportunities

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor of Organic Chemistry (f/m/d) (Professor/in - Hochschulen)
jobs.description:
Constructor University (formerly Jacobs University) is a private, state-accredited, English-language university in Bremen. We offer Bachelor, Master, and PhD programs in three schools: School of Science, School of Computer Science and Engineering, and School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. Our principles are first-class teaching and research, international diversity, and multidisciplinary cooperation. Constructor University consistently achieves top results in national and international university rankings. As an international university, we attract highly talented and open-minded students from all over the world. Currently, over 1.800 students from 110 nations live and study on our residential campus.

Constructor University is seeking to fill a tenure-track faculty position in organic chemistry with a focus on synthetic organic chemistry, and we invite applications from interested candidates for the following position, to be filled ideally by January 2027:

Assistant Professor of Organic Chemistry (f/m/d)
(full-time, tenure-track, initially limited to 3 years)

Your Responsibilities:

The School of Science is particularly interested in a candidate who combines experimental and computational or theoretical approaches for the development of synthetic methodology and synthesis of bioactive molecules or functional materials. The implementation of AI, machine learning, or data-driven control / optimization is highly welcome, for example, for synthesis planning, activity prediction, sensing, or structural topology. The successful candidate is expected to engage in innovative research in organic chemistry and to maintain a cutting-edge, externally funded research program that energizes the School of Science.

The successful candidate will conduct teaching in the field of organic chemistry, including fundamental and advanced lectures and laboratories at the BSc, MSc, and PhD level. The expertise in teaching organic chemistry forms an integral part of the basic education in the BSc programs “Chemistry and Biotechnology” and “Medicinal Chemistry and Chemical Biology”. Moreover, the candidate is expected to take a pivotal role in the MSc programs “Quantitative Life Science” and/or “Advanced Materials” with complementary research experience and via the development and implementation of innovative, pedagogically sound approaches to online, hybrid and in-person teaching and learning. This will also include the advising of students on their studies, and the supervision of Bachelor, Master, and PhD theses as well as research projects.

The university is highly supportive of junior faculty, providing both formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, as well as a flexible budget for establishing an internationally visible research group. The University offers in-house adequate shared analytical research facilities, including NMR spectrometers, single crystal diffractometers, and high-resolution mass spectrometers.                                                            

Your Qualifications and Experience:

- PhD degree in Organic Chemistry
- Strong publication record in relevant international journals
- Experience in the acquisition of third-party funding is desirable
- Experience in successful teaching in international and diverse environments, integrating innovative teaching and learning approaches.
- Inclination for collaboration with CU faculty and for transfer of research knowledge into applications
- Responsible, self-motivated person able to work independently and as a part of a team
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, the language of instruction and communication on campus
- Intercultural experience and competence
- Ideally, the successful candidate should be eligible for an ERC starting grant.

Senior Auditor / R&D Quality Manager (m/f/d)

Stellen-ID: 22169
Standort: Frankfurt am Main

We are searching intelligent and innovative employees. If you are interested in working for a dynamic company with flat hierarchy, we look forward to receiving your application.

Your tasks:

- Plan and conduct clinical project audits, process audits, and supplier/vendor audits in accordance with GxP and regulatory requirements.
- Develop and maintain risk-based audit plans and study assessment strategies
- Evaluate audit findings, ensure proper documentation, and support CAPA development and follow-up
- Lead and manage quality escalations arising from clinical study activities
- Contribute to the development and maintenance of the Quality Management System, including SOPs, CAPA, deviations, and document control
- Provide quality consultation to Clinical Operations teams on study processes and quality-related topics
- Support qualification and evaluation of clinical service providers such as CROs, laboratories, couriers, and archiving services
- Deliver training on GCP, Good Clinical Laboratory Practice, and other quality-related topics

Your profile:

- University degree in a scientific or technical field such as Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or Medical Technology
- Several years of experience in Quality Management, Clinical Research, or auditing within a GxP/GCP-regulated environment
- Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements for medical devices and pharmaceuticals
- Proven experience in planning, conducting, and following up on internal and external audits
- Solid understanding of CAPA processes, deviation management, and document control systems
- Strong analytical skills and a structured, risk-based approach to quality oversight
- Excellent communication and advisory skills when working with cross-functional teams and external partners
- Very good command of English (written and spoken)

You can expect ...

- Experience in exciting and international projects
- Continuous salary development
- Da Vinci Corporate Benefits
- On-the-job training and language courses

As a Quality Conformance Manager (d/m/w) in Hamburg, the role focuses on quality assurance, structured problem solving and process excellence within a global operations and training environment. The position coordinates quality notifications and corrective actions across the spare parts and kits portfolio while serving as an important interface between international teams, technical experts and customer-facing functions.

- Monitor, validate and analyse incoming Notification of Escape (NOE) and Quality Survey Report (QSR) requests, assessing their operational impact on spare parts and kits.
- Define, coordinate and implement rapid containment measures to mitigate quality defects and prevent non-conforming items from affecting customer operations.
- Manage Discrepancy Reports related to NOE, QSR and CAPRI processes, ensuring that quality tasks are validated, assigned, tracked and closed efficiently.
- Coordinate Airworthiness Directive analysis and resolution, including the structured assessment of safety-related items and the implementation of appropriate follow-up actions.
- Represent QSR processes during internal and external quality audits and demonstrate compliance with applicable aerospace quality standards.
- Work with international colleagues and global expert networks to align containment activities, exchange specialist knowledge and resolve complex quality topics.
- Contribute QSR expertise to cross-functional transformation initiatives, process management activities and continuous process improvement projects.
- Support customer satisfaction by applying structured problem-solving methods and maintaining a consistent focus on quality, reliability and timely resolution.
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

- Completed technical education or a relevant qualification in aircraft construction, engineering, or aerospace; comparable expertise in an aerospace-related discipline is suitable.
- Several years of professional experience in aircraft manufacturing, aerospace mechanics, quality management, quality assurance, maintenance, or upkeep/maintenance services.
- Practical knowledge of process improvement, process management, and Total Quality Management, including structured problem-solving methods.
- Experience in analyzing quality deviations, coordinating containment activities, and driving corrective actions through to completion.
- Ability to work independently, organize priorities effectively, and maintain a high level of attention to detail when handling complex quality topics.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in multifunctional teams and with international expert networks.
- Confident German and English language skills for professional communication in a global working environment.
- Working conditions include full-time employment with 35 hours per week.
Benefits:

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around 72.000 €
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

As a Supplier Quality Manager (d/f/m) in Hamburg, you will work across the cabin perimeter and help safeguard reliable supplier performance throughout the aerospace supply chain. The role combines Supply Chain, Logistics, supplier quality, risk management and continuous improvement activities in an international operating environment.

Your tasks:

- Monitor supplier delivery, quality and cost performance using relevant key performance indicators, and initiate immediate containment actions where required to protect industrial operations.
- Coordinate and follow up on recovery plans with suppliers when delivery reliability or product quality declines.
- Support the industrial qualification of products and suppliers in line with supplier requirements and applicable airworthiness, safety and industrial standards.
- Conduct industrial supplier audits and assessments, documenting findings and coordinating appropriate improvement measures.
- Develop the capacity and capabilities of cabin suppliers through continuous-improvement approaches, including APQP, Lean methods and joint supplier-development activities.
- Monitor new product introductions and transfers of work across the Lieferkette to maintain end-to-end consistency and on-time, on-quality performance.
- Identify and manage industrial risks in cooperation with internal and external stakeholders, applying structured Risikomanagement and Total Quality Management principles.
- Manage interfaces with program teams, final assembly operations and other internal stakeholders, while communicating effectively with contacts at different levels of supplier organizations.
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

- Completed studies or comparable qualifications in aerospace, engineering, industrial engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics or a related technical or commercial discipline.
- Practical experience in Lieferantenmanagement, Supply Chain Quality, Qualitätsmanagement or Qualitätssicherung; experience in the Luft- und Raumfahrt environment is advantageous.
- Sound understanding of quality-management methods and tools such as APQP, Control Plans, PFMEA, 8D/9S, VSM or comparable problem-solving approaches.
- Knowledge of Supply Chain processes, supplier performance management, industrial qualification, audits and continuous-improvement activities.
- Experience with Risikomanagement and TQM, meaning Total Quality Management, including the structured analysis of causes, risks and improvement measures.
- Confident use of Windows-based working environments and SAP/R3; familiarity with Google Workspace is also expected.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to quickly understand functional processes, dependencies and operational interrelationships.
- Independent, structured and results-oriented approach, combined with reliable deadline and workflow coordination.
- Very good German and business-fluent English skills; French is an advantage.
- Willingness to travel worldwide up to approximately once per month is required.
- Full-time employment with 35 hours per week.
Benefits:

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around 75.000 €
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

As Digital Project Coordinator (d/m/w), you will combine digital expertise with project management business partnering in Hamburg. The role focuses on supporting cabin development through data-driven solutions, effective project steering and continuous process improvement.

Your tasks:

- Develop and maintain dashboards, visualisations and performance-monitoring solutions for business and project data.
- Support data migration activities, including the transition of reporting data from QlikSense to Skywise.
- Analyse data, identify trends and translate findings into practical recommendations for business and digital development stakeholders.
- Contribute to the setup, planning, execution and closure of projects, including operational follow-up and performance controlling.
- Coordinate stakeholder management across business departments, digital teams and project participants, ensuring clear communication and aligned requirements.
- Apply project management methods and tools while supporting integrated project planning, prioritisation and requirements management.
- Contribute to risk management, opportunity management, quality management and structured problem-solving within project activities.
- Support the practical use of generative artificial intelligence, prompt development and local AI enablement, including the creation of reusable knowledge and process solutions.
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

- Completed technical or comparable degree at least at Bachelor's level, ideally with a focus related to technology, data or project management.
- One year of professional experience in project management and practical knowledge of project steering, planning and performance controlling.
- Several years of experience in data analysis and programming, with knowledge of Java, Python, SQL and HTML; experience with dashboarding and data visualisation is valuable.
- Understanding of data migration, process optimisation, requirements management and the application of digital tools in operational environments.
- Basic knowledge of change management, risk management and quality management, combined with a structured approach to problem-solving.
- Strong analytical thinking, confidence with numbers and the ability to convert complex information into clear, actionable conclusions.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organisational skills, together with a proactive, independent and collaborative working style.
- Good prioritisation skills and a confident, approachable manner when working with different teams and interest groups.
- Negotiation-level English and basic German skills; knowledge of Google Workspace is expected. A project management certification and familiarity with the relevant organisation are advantageous.
- Full-time availability with a working schedule of 35 hours per week.
Benefits:

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around 72.000 €
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment
